reason: Light mode is exposed as menuitem with no checked state, so its selected or unselected state is not in the accessibility tree. The three theme options are plain menuitems with no menuitemradio role and no aria-checked; the check icon beside the selected option is aria-hidden, so which theme is active is shown visually only (4.1.2, 1.3.1). The parent Appearance item reads System default in its name and the options still work, so the impact is minor.
